payload.text: /plumb:plumb intent Rethink plumb's log: say what it must keep durably and share across branches and machines (your words, the judge's approvals, test evidence, why links moved) and what is local housekeeping that never needs committing. Make its tamper check hold when several sessions and branches write at once, so a merge never breaks on another session's uncommitted entries. Keep the repo from growing without bound.
